mapper.select: select count(case when status=3 then 1 end) as successCount, count(case when status=2 then 1 end) as failedCount, count(case when status=3 then 1 WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 end) as totalCount from artifact_sync_record where create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY);

select count(case when status=3 then 1 end) as successCount, count(case when status=2 then 1 end) as failedCount, count(case when status=3 then 1 WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 end) as totalCount, DATE(create_time) AS date from artifact_sync_record where create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) group by DATE(create_time);

select sum(sr.file_size) as fileSize, ar.source_repository_id as repositoryId from artifact_sync_slave_record as sr, artifact_sync_record as ar where sr.sync_no = ar.sync_no and ar.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) group by ar.source_repository_id order by fileSize desc limit #{limitNumber}
SELECT DISTINCT sr.sync_no FROM artifact_sync_slave_record ssr JOIN artifact_sync_record sr ON ssr.sync_no = sr.sync_no WHERE sr.status < 3 AND ssr.target_path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%')
